scrapers.name: AnimeKai
scrapers.description: Anime · Japanese Sub · AnimeKai.li / MegaVid · HTTP only
scrapers.author: CloudAnime
scrapers.notes: Uses the website-published noax=1 source fallback to avoid the Animex relay. User logs and live replay confirmed HTTP403 on later video segments for MAL54492/42249 while root/early video loaded; refresh=1 did not fix the sampled failures. Fallback segments at corresponding playback positions returned HTTP206 MPEG-TS. Discovery remains exact ARM/AniZip mapping plus source JSON and master HLS; no extra segment/subtitle probes or app-specific logic. Three HTTP calls for a unique season. Android confirmation remains pending for this fallback fix.

scrapers.description: Anime · Japanese Sub · HD-1 + HD-2 · Provider-defined HLS instructions v1
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: Removes TMDB episode request incompatible with VUEO metadata broker. Ambiguous season mapping requires explicit ARM same-number TMDB/TVDB season link plus matching AniZip TMDB/TVDB/AniList identities and exact TVDB episode. No title hardcoding, dates, fuzzy match, first-result fallback or guessed absolute offsets. Unresolved/conflicting cases skip. Extraction unchanged.

scrapers.name: VidNest
scrapers.description: Anime · Japanese Sub · Aniwave · HTTP only
scrapers.author: CloudAnime
scrapers.notes: Rebuilt for the current VidNest Aniwave Sub API. Exact ARM/AniZip title and episode mapping; no fuzzy search or guessed season offsets. Authenticated AES-GCM decoding inside the provider, no external decrypt service. Master HLS validation, English/Malay/Indo subtitle metadata, shared HTTP playback transport. No old backend, Dub/Hindi, HiAnime duplicate engine, WebView, child/segment/subtitle preflight. User confirmed playback on Android. v2.0.1 changes the file path to providers/vidnest.js; extraction unchanged. Stable provider ID retained for existing toggles.

scrapers.name: AnimeNoSub
scrapers.description: Anime · Japanese audio · Sub only · English, Malay and Indo subtitles
scrapers.author: CloudAnime
scrapers.notes: Direct AnimeNoSub website provider with verified MAL/episode mapping. Nova, Vidmoly, Vtube, FileMoon (legacy packed JW and current Byse AES-GCM), StreamWish packed JW/links and MegaPlay AES-CBC enc plus CDN token supported. Resolves direct.php Sub wrappers. Explicit Dub labels/paths remain excluded; server names do not need a Sub keyword. Authenticated GCM decryption, bounded requests, independent host failures, master HLS priority, and English/Malay/Indo subtitle filtering. Current MegaPlay player constants verified on 2026-10-12; upstream key rotations may require updates. HLS content validation is not a full playback claim.

scrapers.name: AnimeDunya
scrapers.description: Anime · Japanese audio · Sub only · English, Malay and Indo subtitles
scrapers.author: CloudAnime
scrapers.notes: Direct anime-dunya.com MAL/episode player extraction. Strict existing TMDB season mapping plus Japanese AniList identity. Reads Next.js Flight JSON without executing downloaded scripts, verifies player MAL/episode, validates HLS and available English/Malay/Indo WebVTT tracks. Master HLS priority. No account cookies or API proxy required for publicly returned sources. Live playback in VUEO remains unverified. v1.0.1: preserves published subtitle URLs without blocking VTT preflight; includes name/label and language/lang/srclang metadata. Player loads subtitles using the supplied CDN headers.

scrapers.name: AnimeOnsen
scrapers.description: Anime · Japanese audio · Sub only · DASH + English, Malay and Indo subtitles
scrapers.author: CloudAnime
scrapers.notes: Direct www.animeonsen.xyz anonymous-session API adapter. Strict date-based TMDB-to-MAL episode mapping, Japanese AniList identity, exact upstream metadata MAL match, verified episode key and MPD; rejects foreign labelled audio and DRM. Preserves published subtitle URLs and per-track Authorization headers. No fuzzy identity fallback, no dub requests. Live homepage returned Cloudflare 403 in build environment; end-to-end live playback remains unverified. Session bootstrap fields and endpoint schema adapted from Anivexa-API reference fetched 2026-10-12. v1.0.1: declares ASS MIME text/x-ssa for native extensionless subtitle endpoints, preserving WebVTT/SubRip/TTML for explicitly suffixed URLs. Fixes missing format metadata which made the player default to SubRip. Runtime logs subtitle format without URLs/tokens. Live on-device rendering remains to be verified.

scrapers.name: AnimeGG
scrapers.description: Anime · Sub only · Direct MP4/HLS · Japanese audio
scrapers.author: CloudAnime
scrapers.notes: Direct www.animegg.org website extractor. Existing verified TMDB-to-MAL episode mapping; conservative exact mapped title/Anime-Planet slug match, site heading and explicit Sub episode/server tabs. No speculative sequel offsets or fuzzy franchise fallback. Parses data literals without eval. Extracts published MP4 URLs without blocking HEAD probes; HLS master priority per embed. English/Malay/Indo sidecars only if returned by player. A sampled Sub episode publishes MP4 sources without external subtitle tracks; hardsub language/audio have not been independently verified. Live in-app playback remains to be tested. v1.0.1: accepts show-wide ARM mappings; verifies absolute numbering against independent TVDB episode identity and broadcast date, preserves relative season date mapping. Logs absent Sub episodes. No guessed offsets.

scrapers.name: Ani.pm
scrapers.description: Anime · Japanese audio · Sub only · Softsub/Hardsub HLS
scrapers.author: CloudAnime
scrapers.notes: Standalone ani.pm API/Settlar extractor. Verified TMDB/IMDb-to-MAL mapping including independently corroborated absolute episodes. Requires exact MAL/AniList search and bootstrap identities, exact episode and effective Sub language/package. Requests only published sub/subhard channels, requires Japanese session audio and rejects foreign/mixed/unverified HLS audio groups. Validates HLS and gives first master priority per channel. External English/Malay/Indo subtitles require recognized actual VTT/ASS/SRT cues with explicit MIME and headers. Live One Piece E1156 soft/hard masters and English VTT retrieved and replay tested; actual in-app video playback remains to be verified. No proxy backend, cookies, runtime imports or dub requests. v1.0.1: builds session query explicitly because VUEO URL.searchParams mutations do not update href; fixes HTTP 400 from missing session parameters. v1.0.2: forwards Settlar session keyProof in X-Settlar-Key-Proof playback headers, as required by the site player for protected HLS keys. Adds one child-playlist preflight per master/channel with safe encryption/proof diagnostics. Device HTTP403 resolution remains unverified. v1.0.3: removes the additional child-playlist preflight introduced in v1.0.2. Retains original master priority and session headers. This is a scan-overhead rollback, not a confirmed HTTP403 playback fix.
